# theme=nb/mb desktop — Layer Documentation

Source: [Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/Afu8S0vVgbGLRWTcZCiHYG/Foundations_for-AI?node-id=5299-6232)

## View (actual export)

Real PNG export from Figma — exact visual match, not a CSS approximation. Self-contained (base64 embedded), no separate PNG needed.

![AI Skin desktop view](data:image/png;base64,)

## Overview

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Name | theme=nb/mb desktop |
| Node ID | `5299:6232` |
| Type | COMPONENT (symbol) |
| Position | x: 471, y: 29 |
| Dimensions | 1050 × 682 |

This is the **desktop variant** of the same `Theme` component used in the mobile frame (`theme=nb/mb mobile`, documented in `frame-2147234834-layers.md` in this same folder). Full node also contains the desktop chat UI (Header, Content, Left/Right Panels) — this doc focuses on the **BG** layer, matching the scope of the other files in this folder.

## Layer Tree (BG)

```
SYMBOL "theme=nb/mb desktop" [5299:6232] 1050x682
  └── FRAME "BG" [5299:4381] 1120x1624
        ├── ROUNDED-RECTANGLE "64e9502e4159bed6f8f57b071db5ac7e 2" [5299:4382] 2705x3607
        ├── FRAME "Gradient circles" [5299:4383] 1667x1996
        │     ├── ELLIPSE "Ellipse 6469" [5299:4384] 819x819
        │     ├── ELLIPSE "Ellipse 6473" [5299:4385] 819x819
        │     ├── ELLIPSE "Ellipse 6472" [5299:4386] 819x819
        │     └── ELLIPSE "Ellipse 6470" [5299:4387] 731x731
        ├── VECTOR "Ellipse 6474" [5299:4388] 992x496
        └── ROUNDED-RECTANGLE "Rectangle 48118123" [5299:4389] 1120x1315
```

Structure pulled directly from Figma `get_metadata` on the symbol (`5299:6232`).

Compared to the mobile BG, the desktop version adds one extra layer: **Vector "Ellipse 6474"** (992×496) — not present in the mobile composition. Same 4 gradient-circle ellipses, background rectangle, and bottom rectangle otherwise.

## Rest of the component (not detailed here)

The full symbol also includes, at the same level as BG:
- `Frame 1984078375` — thin top strip
- `Header` — top nav bar
- `Content` — Left Panel (hidden), Middle (chat scroll area), Right Panel (hidden, account picker)

These are UI/product layers, not background — out of scope for this bg-focused doc. Ask if you want a full layer breakdown of the desktop chat UI too.

## Animation / Motion

Checked Figma's motion/keyframe API on this node, recursive — **no native keyframe or Smart Animate motion data returned** (empty result, same as the mobile version).

## Notes

- Same visual system as the mobile "AI Skin BG": blurred background rectangle + 4 heavily blurred gradient ellipses (radius ~300 in mobile equivalents) + bottom gradient rectangle fade.
- Background image is embedded inline (base64) — this file is self-contained.
